decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed hairdressing salon, by reason of design and access would not preserve or enhance the character of the Turnham Green Conservation Area. The design is not consistent with the character of the market stalls located on Essex Place Square. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy ENV B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), S.4.2 (Shop Front Design) and ENV B.1.1 (New Development) of the Unitary Development Plan and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposed hairdressing salon, by reason of access and design does not make sufficient provision for access to the premises. The access does not accord with the Mayor's Supplementary Planning Guidance for the London Plan. Accordingly, the proposal is considered to be inconsistent with the Supplementary Planning Guidance to the London Plan.

Condition : 3 - The proposed hairdressing salon, by reason of location and design, does not make sufficient provision for road safety. The hairdressing salon would be located on the paving stones adjacent to the footpath, removing sufficient space between the road carriageway and the structure. Accordingly, the proposal is considered contrary to ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) T.2.1 (Pedestrian Access) and T.2.2 (Pedestrian Safety and Security) of the Unitary Development Plan.
description: Reconstruction of a market stall to be a single storey hairdressing saloon.
